concept.description: HTTP entry point. Label :Endpoint on the method with properties httpMethod and fullPath.
Method/type carrying an authorization check (label :Authorized, property authExpr).
Labels methods whose name matches the parameter sensitiveRegex (getters of secrets / PII) as :SensitiveValue.
concept.cypher: MATCH (:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE NOT t:Test AND m.name IS NOT NULL AND m.name =~ $sensitiveRegex SET m:SensitiveValue RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS SensitiveValues

constraint.description: Every endpoint must carry an authorization check unless its path matches publicPathRegex.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:Endpoint) WHERE NOT t:Test AND NOT m:Authorized AND NOT t:Authorized AND NOT coalesce(m.fullPath, '') =~ $publicPathRegex RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, m.httpMethod + ' ' + coalesce(m.fullPath, '') AS Detail

constraint.description: Destructive endpoints (migrate, clear, reload, sync...) must require an administrator role.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:Endpoint) WHERE NOT t:Test AND coalesce(m.fullPath, '') =~ $destructivePathRegex AND (m.authExpr IS NULL OR NOT m.authExpr =~ $adminExprRegex) RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, m.httpMethod + ' ' + m.fullPath AS Detail

constraint.description: Internal service-to-service paths (parameter internalPathRegex) must not be reachable by end users: protect them at the gateway and with service authentication.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:Endpoint) WHERE NOT t:Test AND coalesce(m.fullPath, '') =~ $internalPathRegex RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, m.httpMethod + ' ' + m.fullPath AS Detail

constraint.description: A method must not log a sensitive value (password, token, secret, PII).

group.description: xc-security - transversal security rules (abstract labels only)
